subject: Kickoff: AFE - automated feature engineering as a platform play
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off AFE. The product thesis: every tabular ML team at Meridian burns weeks hand-crafting features. AFE learns which engineered features help a downstream task, using feature importance masks - local and global masking to pick the best transform functions per feature. If we get this right it becomes a self-serve service, not a library.

Milestones inside our window (4/27 - 8/10):
- Reproduce the discovery-model trainer on the housing-price regression benchmark by end of May.
- Internal alpha with two partner teams in June.
- Service-ized version plus launch review by early August.

Ivo owns the staffing plan and the buy-vs-build calls on serving infra. Linnea and Yusuf on the masking/selection research, Rosa and Giannis on the service.

Anders
